description: This source file defines a generic CRUD factory for Mongoose models, with tenant enforcement, request validation, caching, and error handling for REST API endpoints.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the sort string against allowed fields, ensuring safe sorting for database queries.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Enforces maximum page size limit to prevent server overload.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieve cached list response if available and not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Cache the list response payload with a TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key based on request parameters for list endpoints.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes input payload for create/update, stripping client-provided tenant identifiers and injecting tenantId from request.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges user-provided filter with enforcement of tenant scope, removing client-side tenant hints.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Builds a REST API controller with list, getById, create, update, remove methods, handling tenant enforcement, caching, error mapping, and optimized database querying.
